   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      6 avis récents mentionnent bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 18 juin 2026 - 29 août 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _beescobee_, 29 août 2026, 1/5: "Unfortunately this app has been unusable for me. The AI ads (ads for games that use AI art and AI-generated people playing them) don’t go away and the fact that so much of this app consists of AI (the music, the art) is really annoying and disappointing. Also, I have a feeling Nintendo will sue them for using songs from their games… I highly doubt they had those approved. The only feature I enjoyed was the fact that people are utilizing this to get things done but honestly, you don’t need the app to do this."
            2. _handysuchtiii_, 18 juin 2026, 1/5: "The app crashes a few seconds after I open it."
            3. _katsilt_, 24 août 2026, 2/5: "the app kept crashing no matter what i did"
